([[La Crosse, Wisconsin]]) | college = [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]] (2020–2022) | highlights = * [[Jerry West Award]] (2022) * [[Lute Olson Award]] (2022) * Consensus first-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2022 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2022]]) * [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]] (2022) * First-team All-[[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] (2022) * [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] (2020) [[Maui Invitational Tournament]] MVP | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|the {{bk|USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|FIBA Under-19 World Cup]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2021 Latvia]]|[[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Jonathan Christian Davis''' (born February 27, 2002) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin Badgers]]. ==High school career== Davis played basketball for [[La Crosse Central High School]] in [[La Crosse, Wisconsin]]. He won a Division 2 state title as a freshman.{{cite web |title=No. 1: La Crosse Central boys basketball wins first state title since 1925 |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/no-1-la-crosse-central-boys-basketball-wins-first-state-title-since-1925/article_0a683a76-ea3a-5625-872d-778dba57b06c.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=December 30, 2017}} In his junior season, Davis averaged 23 points and nine rebounds per game, earning ''La Crosse Tribune'' Player of the Year honors.{{cite web |last1=Sommerfeldt |first1=Todd |title=All-Tribune boys basketball: La Crosse Central's Johnny Davis is player of the year |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/all-tribune-boys-basketball-la-crosse-centrals-johnny-davis-is-player-of-the-year/article_67ee1159-6ee6-561d-ae84-c95cfaa222b2.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 7, 2019}} As a senior, he averaged 27.4 points and 9.2 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Lee |first1=Eric |title=High school basketball: Johnny Davis dazzled for La Crosse Central, looks to do the same for Badgers |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/high-school-basketball-johnny-davis-dazzled-for-la-crosse-central-looks-to-do-the-same/article_bff330b3-7652-522b-8cbd-10596ab38141.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 12, 2020}} He was named [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] and repeated as ''La Crosse Tribune'' Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Sommerfeldt |first1=Todd |title=All-Tribune boys basketball: Johnny Davis is player of the year |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/all-tribune-boys-basketball-johnny-davis-is-player-of-the-year/article_95c04708-2e8c-5dcc-a81e-c774e2673d04.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=April 20, 2020}} Davis left as his school's all-time leading scorer with 2,158 career points.{{cite web |last1=McNamara |first1=Jon |title=WBCA tabs Wisconsin signee Jonathan Davis as Mr. Basketball |url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/wbca-tabs-wisconsin-signee-jonathan-davis-as-player-of-the-year |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=June 13, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]] over offers from [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]], [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] and [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]], among others.{{cite web |last1=Potrykus |first1=Jeff |title=Davis brothers from La Crosse commit to play basketball for Wisconsin |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2019/06/15/davis-brothers-la-crosse-commit-play-basketball-wisconsin/1469654001/ |website=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=June 15, 2019}} Davis also played [[American football|football]] for La Crosse Central as a [[quarterback]].{{cite web |last1=Sommerfeldt |first1=Todd |title=High school football: Johnny Davis left significant mark at La Crosse Central |url=https://lacrossetribune.com/sports/local/preps/football/high-school-football-johnny-davis-left-significant-mark-at-la-crosse-central/article_356d80aa-a67b-5e12-9df8-78354ab660a2.html |website=[[La Crosse Tribune]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=October 30, 2019}} In his senior season, he earned Large Schools First Team All-State honors and won the Dave Krieg Award as the most outstanding senior quarterback in Wisconsin.{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Travis |title=Johnny Davis of La Crosse Central selected to receive Dave Krieg Award |url=https://www.wissports.net/news_article/show/1066149 |website=Wisconsin Sports Network |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=November 20, 2019}} ==College career== On February 2, 2021, Davis scored a freshman season-high 17 points, shooting 6-of-7 from the field, in a 72–56 win over [[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State]].{{cite web |last1=Vazquez |first1=Raul |title=The "sky’s the limit" for Wisconsin freshman wing Jonathan Davis |url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/the-sky-s-the-limit-for-wisconsin-freshman-wing-jonathan-davis |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=February 4, 2021}} As a freshman, he came off the bench, averaging seven points and 4.1 rebounds per game while leading his team with 34 steals.{{cite web |last1=Polzin |first1=Jim |title=Badgers freshman Jonathan Davis earns tryout with US U19 National Team |url=https://madison.com/wsj/sports/college/basketball/men/badgers-freshman-jonathan-davis-earns-tryout-with-us-u19-national-team/article_c0feef39-595a-57fb-94f7-2d24f3d882c5.html |website=[[Wisconsin State Journal]] |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=May 6, 2021}} On November 23, 2021, Davis scored 30 points in a 65–63 upset of [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]].{{cite news |title=Wisconsin holds off No. 12 Houston with 65–63 upset |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401376724 |access-date=November 29, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 23, 2021}} He scored a career-high 37 points and had 14 rebounds on January 3, 2022, in a 74–69 upset of [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]].{{cite news |last1=Manderfeld |first1=Noah |title=Johnny Davis scores 37 as Wisconsin pulls off the upset, beats No. 3 Purdue on the road |url=https://www.wsaw.com/2022/01/04/johnny-davis-scores-35-wisconsin-pulls-off-upset-beats-no-3-purdue-road/ |access-date=January 3, 2022 |work=WSAW |date=January 3, 2022}} As a sophomore, he averaged 19.7 points and 8.2 rebounds per game. Davis was named [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]].{{cite press release|url=https://bigten.org/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|title=2021-22 Big Ten Men’s Basketball Postseason Honors Announced|publisher=[[Big Ten Conference]] |date=March 8, 2022 |accessdate=March 8, 2022}} On March 31, 2022, Davis declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{Cite web |date=2022-03-31 |title=Badgers' Davis to enter NBA draft, hire agent |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33640802/wisconsin-badgers-johnny-davis-no-9-prospect-espn-100-enter-nba-draft |access-date=2022-03-31 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} He is projected as a possible top ten selection in the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |last=Conway |first=Tyler |title=Wisconsin's Johnny Davis to Enter 2022 NBA Draft, Will Forgo Eligibility, Hire Agent |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10026061-wisconsins-johnny-davis-to-enter-2022-nba-draft-will-forgo-eligibility-hire-agent |access-date=2022-03-31 |website=Bleacher Report |language=en}} ==National team career== Davis represented the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States]] at the [[2021 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2021 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]] in Latvia. He averaged 4.1 points per game, helping his team win the gold medal.{{cite web |last1=Schnable |first1=Abby |title=Jonathan Davis, Team USA become gold medalists in FIBA U19 World Cup |url=https://madison.com/wsj/sports/college/basketball/men/jonathan-davis-team-usa-become-gold-medalists-in-fiba-u19-world-cup/article_b91ff5db-15af-510a-898f-9af9b936826e.html |website=[[Wisconsin State Journal]] |access-date=July 12, 2021 |date=July 12, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] | '''31''' || 0 || 24.3 || '''.441''' || '''.389''' || .727 || 4.1 || 1.1 || 1.1 || .6 || 7.0 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] | '''31''' || '''31''' || '''34.2''' || .427 || .306 || '''.791''' || '''8.2''' || '''2.1''' || '''1.2''' || '''.7''' || '''19.7''' |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 62 || 31 || 29.2 || .431 || .325 || .779 || 6.2 || 1.6 || 1.1 || .7 || 13.4 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== Davis' father, [[Mark Davis (basketball, born 1963)|Mark]], played professional basketball for 13 seasons, including stints in the [[National Basketball Association]], following a college career at [[Old Dominion Monarchs basketball|Old Dominion]]. His twin brother, Jordan, plays college basketball for [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]] and was his basketball and football teammate in high school.{{cite web |last1=Lucas |first1=Mike |title=Lucas: Johnny Davis pairs quiet confidence with loud game |url=https://uwbadgers.com/news/2020/10/30/mens-basketball-lucas-johnny-davis-pairs-calm-confidence-with-lively-basketball-game.aspx |website=Wisconsin Badgers |access-date=June 14, 2021 |date=October 30, 2020}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://uwbadgers.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jonathan-davis/9712 Wisconsin Badgers bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/d/davis-jonathan.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{navboxes|list= {{2022 NCAA Men's Basketball Consensus All-Americans}} {{Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{Jerry West Award}} {{Lute Olson Award}} }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Davis, Jonathan}} [[Category:2002 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:All-American college men's basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Wisconsin]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from La Crosse, Wisconsin]] [[Category:Twin sportspeople]] [[Category:Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball players]]
